resolvedIssues: PostgreSQL migration advisory lock now remains on one dedicated SQL session through lock, migration and unlock.
Runtime readiness now reflects actual database health instead of staying true after PostgreSQL loss.
Initialized/accepting persistence state is separated from current health so transient outages retain/coalesce bounded work and shutdown remains deterministic.
Database recovery uses one bounded exponential-backoff probe lane with two-success hysteresis instead of retry storms.
Persistence archive now preserves full canonical lineage with SHA-256 integrity, 0600 atomic files and safe empty/explicit-replace restore modes.
SQLite-to-PostgreSQL archive migration, PostgreSQL pool contention and Windows archive compile are covered by qualification.
